title: Uniqueness with fixed prime-power local pinnings
statement: Let $\ell$ be a prime, $n\geq1$, $\Lambda=\mathbf Z/\ell^n\mathbf Z$, and $T$ a Noetherian excellent scheme on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-exc-excellent-ring]. Fix a dimension function $\delta$ and use pinned potential dualizing complexes as in [def-per-potential-dualizing-complex]. There exists such a complex for $(T,\delta,\Lambda)$. Any two such complexes admit a unique pinning-preserving isomorphism. Every such complex belongs to the bounded constructible etale category $D^b_c(T_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes] and has finite Tor amplitude, meaning that its derived tensor with an arbitrary module sheaf in degree zero has cohomology in a fixed finite interval [def-kun-derived-tensor]. Uniqueness refers to complexes with their pinnings, and does not assert uniqueness of unnormalized dualizing objects.

mathlib_searches.query: Potential dualizing complexes on excellent schemes exist and are unique up to unique pinning preserving isomorphism
Residue compatible local cohomology pinnings uniquely determine a bounded constructible dualizing complex

from.place: Proof, Step 3: dimension-normalized Verdier duality; finite torsion regular local model in the generic shifted ordinary classes, made precise by Uniqueness with fixed prime-power local pinnings.
